scope: Prospective inexpensive decomposition of the observed PN629 sham change; no new CNS execution or stage3 criterion
observation_before_plan: 400ms sham changed from +0.075606563 degrees in parent to +0.023686321 degrees with PN629 disabled before preparation

rivals.A: Changed neural commands explain the yaw change
rivals.B: Changed prepared mechanical/controller state explains the yaw change
rivals.C: An interaction between prepared state and command is material

operation: 2x2 body/controller prepared state (parent or PN629-disabled) crossed with saved sham command stream (parent or PN629-disabled), 400ms and identical MuJoCo/controller implementation
decision: Report additive command and prepared-state effects at parent plus factorial interaction; no winner chosen by a fitted threshold, no recalibration
stop: Run two matched controls first; stop on failed reproduction, nonfinite, warning or budget. Otherwise run two crossed controls. Preserve originals.
